exodus.14.p1.b1.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Tell the Israelites to turn back…You are to encamp by the sea…

exodus.14.p1.b2.text: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart so that he will pursue them…and the Egyptians will know that I am the LORD.

exodus.14.p2.b4.text: What have we done? We have released Israel from serving us.

exodus.14.p2.b5.text: So Pharaoh prepared his chariot and took his army with him. He took 600 of the best chariots, and all the other chariots of Egypt…

exodus.14.p2.b6.text: The Egyptians…pursued the Israelites and overtook them as they camped by the sea…

exodus.14.p3.b7.text: …the Israelites looked up and saw the Egyptians marching after them, and they were terrified and cried out to the LORD.

exodus.14.p3.b8.text: Was it because there were no graves in Egypt that you brought us into the wilderness to die?

exodus.14.p3.b9.text: For it would have been better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in the wilderness.

exodus.14.p4.b10.text: Do not be afraid. Stand firm and you will see the LORD’s salvation, which He will accomplish for you today…

exodus.14.p4.b11.text: The LORD will fight for you; you need only to be still.”

exodus.14.p4.b12.text: The Egyptians you see today, you will never see again.

exodus.14.p5.b13.text: Why are you crying out to Me? Tell the Israelites to go forward.

exodus.14.p5.b14.text: And as for you, lift up your staff and stretch out your hand over the sea and divide it, so that the Israelites can go through the sea on dry ground.

exodus.14.p5.b15.text: The pillar of cloud also moved from before them and stood behind them…The cloud was there in the darkness, but it lit up the night. So all night long neither camp went near the other.

exodus.14.p6.b16.text: Then Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and all that night the LORD drove back the sea with a strong east wind that turned it into dry land. So the waters were divided,

exodus.14.p7.b17.text: and the Israelites went through the sea on dry ground, with walls of water on their right and on their left.

exodus.14.p8.b18.text: And the Egyptians chased after them—all Pharaoh’s horses, chariots, and horsemen—and followed them into the sea.

exodus.14.p8.b20.text: The LORD…threw their camp into confusion. He caused their chariot wheels to wobble, so that they had difficulty driving.

exodus.14.p8.b21.text: Let us flee from the Israelites…for the LORD is fighting for them against Egypt!

exodus.14.p9.b22.text: Stretch out your hand over the sea, so that the waters may flow back over the Egyptians and their chariots and horsemen.

exodus.14.p9.b24.text: The sea returned to its normal state…The waters flowed back and covered the chariots and horsemen…

exodus.14.p9.b25.text: The entire army of Pharaoh that had chased the Israelites into the sea. Not one of them survived.

exodus.14.p10.b26.text: That day the LORD saved Israel from the hand of the Egyptians…

exodus.14.p10.b27.text: When Israel saw the great power that the LORD had exercised over the Egyptians, the people feared the LORD and believed in Him and in His servant Moses.
